observations: Photo 0 shows a used automatic transmission casing on brick pavers with a separate torque converter beside it.
A white label on the casing reads 460; no Mercedes, M278, or G63 marking is legible in any photo.
Photo 1 is a close-up of the torque converter showing internal turbine fins.
Photo 2 shows the bell housing and casing from another angle with mounting points and fluid residue.
The watermark FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL LIMITED appears across all three photos.

identity.kind: used automatic transmission gearbox with torque converter

claims.claim: M278 1282 OEM G63 Mercedes transmission gearbox
claims.evidence: No Mercedes logo, M278, or G63 marking is readable in photos 0, 1, or 2; only a label with 460 is visible.
Photos show the exterior only; no operation, test bench, or installation video is provided.

risks.risk: Internal transmission function cannot be confirmed; unit may be seized, slipping, or internally damaged.
risks.proof: Video of the unit running on a transmission test bench or installed and shifting through gears.

risks.risk: Seals and gaskets may leak; external photos cannot confirm fluid retention.
risks.proof: Close-up video of all sealing surfaces after cleaning, or a pressure/leak test.
risks.if_unproven: priced as leaking or requiring reseal

risks.risk: Claimed M278/G63 fitment may be wrong; an incorrect part number would make it unsuitable for the stated application.
risks.proof: Photo of the full identification label matched to Mercedes EPC or the seller's vehicle VIN.

risks.risk: Torque converter may be damaged or mismatched to the transmission.
risks.proof: Video showing the converter installed and turning freely, or matching part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as converter excluded or scrap

proof_requests: Clear photo of the full identification label/sticker on the transmission casing
Video of the transmission operating on a test bench or in a vehicle
Close-up photos of all sealing surfaces and the torque converter mounting face
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used automatic transmission gearbox with torque converter, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working core despite unverified seller claims.
